subtitle: Lesson 17 · System Design for Data Engineers

code:
Shared:  one schema, every row tagged tenant_id
         -- cheapest, weakest isolation
Siloed:  one database/workspace per tenant
         -- strongest isolation, most to operate
Hybrid:  most tenants pooled, big ones siloed
caption: None of these is correct in the abstract.

eyebrow: Enforcing isolation, not just modeling it
code:
CREATE SECURITY POLICY TenantFilter
ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fn_TenantAccessPredicate(tenant_id)
ON dbo.FactOrders
WITH (STATE = ON);
-- every query is filtered automatically, even a new one
caption: A tenant_id column alone can't guarantee this.

code:
Shared Fabric Capacity, many workspaces:
  Tenant A's heavy query --> throttles everyone else
Siloed capacity per tenant:
  Tenant A's heavy query --> only affects Tenant A
caption: Fabric Lesson 14's capacities make this concrete, not abstract.
